chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: candidate_13 is a feasible optimized lowest-cost incumbent; all other candidates are either optimized challengers (candidate_04, candidate_05) or screened as dominated by the declared lower-activity-and-higher-price rule; the highest-activity candidate candidate_04 differs from candidate_13, and BACKWARD plus TEST_REACHABILITY have quantified and classified the activity-improvement requirement as unreachable. Remaining affordable actions (free reporting already used; lever tests or reference-only reachability) would not plausibly change the industrial choice, while MC/model-validity checks are either unaffordable or not required by the stopping rule.
